note: Influence and approval are gameplay starting values for 1 January 2000 (Obuchi's LDP-led coalition, during the post-bubble slowdown), not measured data. Influence reflects institutional weight: strong business federations (Keidanren) and an influential bureaucracy, organised farmers (JA) tied to the LDP, enterprise unions grouped in Rengo, a large national press, and a constitutionally constrained, civilian-controlled Self-Defense Force.
